description: Defines the CKEDITOR.htmlParser.element class, representing an HTML element with methods for cloning, writing HTML, and managing children and attributes.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser.element
classes.description: A lightweight representation of an HTML element with properties for name, attributes, children, and methods for cloning and HTML output.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of the current element.

methods.name: writeHtml
methods.description: Serializes the element and its children to HTML using a writer, with optional filtering.
